title: Chapter 234: Ranking
content:
Chapter 234: Ranking

"Then do you want to continue to play the rankings this time?"

At this time, Lu Xue spoke on the side.

When Xiao Luo heard this, he was slightly stunned. Yes, Qin Feng came here, could he come to observe his ranking?

Isn't that so full?

Then Xiao Luo looked at Qin Feng with admiration and said, "Brother Qin, you are really a role model for us. I believe you, and you will definitely achieve better results this time."

Regarding Qin Feng, Xiao Luo naturally chose to make friends.

After all, connections are also part of strength.

When I first came to the inner courtyard, I still need to make some friends.

As for Lu Xue beside him, to be honest, he also wanted to make friends with Lu Xue, but the feeling that Lu Xue gave him always made him feel that the two of them were not from the same world.

In other words, not even on one channel.

When Qin Feng heard Xiao Luo's words, his face froze, but looking at Xiao Luo's hot gaze, Qin Feng coughed lightly, "More, thank you."

Looking at the towering martial tower in front of him, Qin Feng swallowed.

The next moment, Qin Feng suddenly sighed, "Oh, I have consumed a lot recently and I have used it for cultivation. I don't have much money, otherwise I will definitely reach the top fifty of the martial arts list."

Speaking of this, Qin Feng shook his head, his face full of regret.

Hearing Qin Feng's words, some young men and women around him who had not left suddenly twitched slightly.

He also reached the top 50 of the martial arts list. Why don’t you beat the top 10 of the martial arts list?

Some people who couldn't listen were even prepared to turn around and leave.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly stood up.

"It's okay, I have money."

As he said that, Lu Xue took out an exquisite ring and handed it to Qin Feng.

Looking at the ring in his hand, Qin Feng was stunned for a long time.

What's the fucking situation?

But then, Qin Feng hurriedly said, "This girl, I don't know you well, ,

How can you harm me? !

Qin Feng didn't finish speaking, just looked at Lu Xue.

Lu Xue showed a wicked smile and said, "It's okay, I'm generous, I'm welcome."

"I hope I can see what your ranking is like."

Xiao Luo looked at Lu Xue so generously and exclaimed in his heart, saying that he was worthy of being that daughter.

A rich woman.

This thigh seems to be tightly held.

At this moment, Qin Feng was already in a mess in the wind. Didn’t he look at the almanac when he went out? Is it so abnormal for newcomers in the inner courtyard now?

And at this time, a few sarcasm sounds came from around.

"Qin Feng, aren't you going to reach the top fifty of the martial arts list? Let's see the style of the top fifty of the fifth list!"

"Yes, Qin Feng, you're so arrogant when you're playing with swords every day. It should be easy for you to hit the top fifty, right?"

Some people didn't want to say much about this, but when they watched Qin Feng pretend in front of the newcomer, especially in front of a rich woman who was fascinating the whole country, everyone suddenly felt itchy.

I deserve it, let you pretend!

"I,,"

Qin Feng listened to everyone's ridicule and looked at the hopeful gazes of Lu Xue and Xiao Luo beside him. Qin Feng gritted his teeth and said in a deep voice: "Okay, just fight!"

It just so happened that someone invited me, and it was a profit no matter how you said it.

Immediately, Qin Feng walked resolutely towards the high tower in front of him.

The tower has a hundred floors, and it goes straight into the sky, with two large gold-plated characters engraved on it - Wu Tower.

As Qin Feng pressed his hand in front of the Martial Tower, the next moment, a halo slowly overflowed from the Martial Tower, directly covering Qin Feng.

Buzz —

Suddenly, Qin Feng disappeared.

The 72nd floor of the Wu Tower also lit up at this moment.

"Damn, this guy is really here!"

"Big, go and tell your senior brother and the others. Qin Feng is here to make the ranking."

For a moment, the people around him became restless.

Lu Xue and Xiao Luo were confused.

No matter how they mean, it seems like they are miserable to play the rankings.

At this time, a young man holding a feather fan and looking gentle, strolled to Lu Xue.

"This girl, let me come down to help you solve your doubts."

The young man held the feather fan and pointed at the martial tower in front of him, and smiled faintly, "There are a total of hundreds of floors in this martial tower, and Qin Feng had seventy-two before, so as soon as he entered the martial tower, he directly teleported to seventy-two. building."

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the others looked at Wuta and nodded slightly.

“Continue.”

The young man smiled slightly and then continued, "There will be a phantom of a strong man on every floor of the Wu Tower, which can perfectly copy the combat power and combat consciousness of the original body, so I want to take my ranking to the next level. , all you have to do is defeat the phantom of the guy in front of you, so that you can defeat the other party's ranking."

"Of course, if you want to challenge the leap layer, it is not possible in the martial arts tower. You can only find the other party privately and fight directly in the competition venue. The ranking is the bet, which is recognized by the academy."

"Oh by the way, even if you die in the Wu Tower, you will be resurrected, but you will be teleported out directly. However, although you are not dead, you will be seriously injured. The most important thing is that there is no surrender in the Wu Tower. ”

The boy smiled and talked freely.

After hearing these words, Lu Xue and the others' doubts were immediately clear.

So that's it.

"Thank you, I'll give you a reward."

Lu Xue threw a ring to the young man.

After taking the ring, the boy nodded and smiled, "A small matter."

But then, the boy was slightly stunned and suddenly became a little angry. Do you think he is a beggar?

Just as he was about to make a statement to restore his image to himself.

The boy subconsciously glanced at the Na Ring, and the next moment, the boy directly took a cold breath.

"Damn."

This is too much.

This was the first time he felt that he had no knowledge, and he gave it a little reward, which was his savings for half a year.

When he swallowed his saliva and looked at Lu Xue again, the boy felt that the woman in front of him was emitting holy lights, which made him a little dazzled.

"In the following court, Xu Zijing."

The boy respectfully clasped his fists at Lu Xue and lowered his head slightly.

This was the first time he faced a peer who lowered his proud head.

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand, "I understand, go down."

From beginning to end, Lu Xue didn't look at Xu Zijing's face.

Seeing this, Xu Zijing smiled bitterly. It seemed that the girl in front of him had no intention of knowing him.

But I think so, this is not a simple background, so how could it be so easy to understand?

Immediately, Xu Zijing looked at Xiao Luo next to him with envy, and turned around and left here.

He was not curious about Qin Feng's result.

After Xu Zijing left, Xiao Luo felt a little happy for some reason.

And just then, a person in the field suddenly exclaimed: "Look at me!"

I saw that the originally lit seventy-second floor suddenly went out, but in a blink of an eye, the seventy-first floor suddenly lit up.

"Seventy-one on the martial arts list!"

"This guy has really become much stronger after not playing the ranking for so long."
